EN: That snarling... Dogs? Wolves? Worse?
ZH: 那咆哮声……是狗？是狼？还是更糟的东西？

EN: I'll head this way.
ZH: 我要走这条路。

EN: Might as well head down here.
ZH: 不妨就从这边走。

EN: My blisters have blisters. Ouch.
ZH: 我的水泡上又长了水泡。好痛。

EN: So tired of walking. My kingdom for a bicycle.
ZH: 走得太累了。真想拿我的王国换辆自行车。

EN: All things considered, this expedition's going pretty well.
ZH: 总的来说，这次探险的进展还不错。

EN: Hello? Heeeelllooo? Nope. Guess I'm alone.
ZH: 喂——？喂~~~~？算了。估计就我一个人。

EN: You know, it's really not so bad out here. Sometimes.
ZH: 说真的，这外面也没那么糟。有时候吧。

EN: Rad detector's going crazy. Must be those green barrels...
ZH: 辐射探测器都快响疯了。肯定是那些绿色桶……

EN: Whoa! Tripped. Gotta be more careful.
ZH: 嗷！绊了一下。得小心点。

EN: Think I'll just walk over here and OW! Twisted my ankle!
ZH: 我就随便沿这边走走——哎哟！崴到脚了！

EN: All these destroyed cars, but they never flew. Guess science missed that boat.
ZH: 满街都是被毁的汽车，可它们从来没飞起来过。看来科学是错过了这一趟。

EN: It's... a motorboat. Stuck into the side of a church. Don't see that every day.
ZH: 这是……一艘摩托艇，直挺挺插在教堂墙上。这可不是天天能见着。

EN: I wonder if elephants still exist.
ZH: 不知道大象还在不在。

EN: May as well follow this blood trail. What could possibly go wrong?
ZH: 干脆顺着血迹走吧。还能出什么岔子呢？

EN: Thirsty. Wonder if I can find a bottle of Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 渴。不知道能不能找到一瓶核子可乐。

EN: A terminal. Really wish I could hack it!
ZH: 一个电脑终端。真希望我能破解它！

EN: Hmm. A chest. Really wish I could pick the lock. I bet there's some great stuff inside.
ZH: 嗯，箱子。真希望我能开锁。我敢打赌里面一定有一些好东西。

EN: A broken bottle, spent ammo casings, drops of blood... Definitely signs of a fight.
ZH: 一个破碎的瓶子、弹壳、几滴血……这里绝对发生过战斗。

EN: I feel exposed. Time to get into cover.
ZH: 我感觉自己完全暴露了。该找掩体了。

EN: Got a weird feeling. Like I'm being watched...
ZH: 有一种奇怪的感觉。好像我一直被监视着……

EN: Should I be walking out in the open like this? Or sneaking? I can never tell.
ZH: 我应该这样光明正大地走过去呢，还是偷偷潜行？永远搞不清状况。

EN: Gunshots to the east. Guess I'll go west.
ZH: 东部有枪声。我应该往西。

EN: Gunshots to the west. Guess I'll go east.
ZH: 西部有枪声。我应该往东。

EN: Gunshots to the north. Guess I'll go south.
ZH: 北部有枪声。我应该往南。

EN: Gunshots to the south. Guess I'll go north.
ZH: 南部有枪声。我应该往北。

EN: Is that... a child? Nope... just the severed head of a doll. Wonderful.
ZH: 那是……一个孩子？不……只是个被砍下来的玩偶脑袋。妙极了。

EN: I really hope I can find my way back to the Vault...
ZH: 我希望我能找到回避难所的路……

EN: Wow, that's a really big pile of rubble. I think I can make it over...
ZH: 哇，真是好大一堆瓦砾。我想我能过去的……

EN: So many big buildings. I wonder if they'll remain standing... forever.
ZH: 这么多的高楼大厦。不知道它们还能不能一直矗立下去……直到永远。

EN: I hear a child crying. Impossible to tell where it's coming from.
ZH: 我听见一个孩子的哭声。不确定它从哪里传来。

EN: I wonder if Brahmin milk is any good. Not that I want to find out.
ZH: 不知道双头牛的奶好不好喝。当然，我可不打算去试。

EN: Still wandering...
ZH: 仍在四处转悠……

EN: Think I'll Wait, what's that? Over there?
ZH: 我想我就——等等，那是什么？那边？

EN: This way looks good.
ZH: 这条路看起来不错。

EN: Too much rubble. Don't think I can get up there.
ZH: 瓦砾也太多了。我大概是爬不上去的。

EN: Hmm. Subway station. I don't think I want to go down there.
ZH: 嗯，地铁站。我不想去那里。

EN: A car tunnel. Sure is dark in there. I think I'll go around.
ZH: 一条汽车隧道。里面可真黑。我还是绕路吧。

EN: Another looted convenience store.
ZH: 另一个被洗劫的便利店。

EN: A broken rifle on the ground. Useless.
ZH: 地面上有一把破枪。没用。

EN: Maybe I'll head back soon.
ZH: 也许我很快就该回去了。

EN: Must go on. For now.
ZH: 得继续走。暂且如此。

EN: I can do this. I can do this. I can do this.
ZH: 我可以的。我可以的。我可以的。

EN: I found an Abandoned Cabin and went inside.
ZH: 发现一座废弃小屋，进去看了看。

EN: I searched through a Super Duper Mart I came across.
ZH: 偶然路过了一个大无敌超市，彻底搜查了一遍。

EN: I discovered and explored a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
ZH: 发现了红火箭服务站，进去探索了一番。

EN: I discovered another Vault and went inside.
ZH: 发现另一个避难所，然后进去了。

EN: I did it. The Savage Dog is dead.
ZH: 我做到了。野狗死了。

EN: The Mole rat has been killed.
ZH: 鼹鼠被我杀了。

EN: I killed the Bloatfly and it exploded into a thousand pieces. Disgusting.
ZH: 我杀死了巨大苍蝇，它炸成了一堆碎块。好恶心。

EN: I squashed the Radroach, no problem.
ZH: 我踩扁了一只辐射蟑螂，小意思。

EN: It was a tough fight, but I killed the Yao Guai.
ZH: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，但我杀死了妖怪熊。

EN: I killed the Feral Ghoul. It was him or me.
ZH: 我杀死了狂尸鬼。不是它死，就是我亡。

EN: I've got some cuts and bruises, but the Giant Ant is dead.
ZH: 我受了些皮肉伤，但巨型蚂蚁死了。

EN: I killed the Scavenger's Dog. Sad, but I had no choice.
ZH: 我杀死了拾荒者的狗。很难过，但我别无选择。

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is dead. That was a close one.
ZH: 巨型工蚁死了。真是惊险的战斗。

EN: I killed the Radscorpion. I can hardly believe it.
ZH: 我杀死了辐射蝎。简直不敢相信。

EN: It was a tough fight but I managed to kill the Giant Soldier Ant.
ZH: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，但我成功杀死了巨型兵蚁。

EN: One Fire Ant Soldier... extinguished!
ZH: 一只火兵蚁……被我消灭了！

EN: I killed the Guard Dog before it could alert anyone to my presence.
ZH: 我赶在看门狗向任何人报信之前，把它杀了。

EN: I barely managed to kill the Fire Ant Warrior.
ZH: 我勉强杀死了火蚁战士。

EN: The Mirelurk is armored everywhere but the face, so I used that to my advantage. It's dead.
ZH: 泥沼蟹浑身都是甲壳，只有脸是弱点，我正好利用了这一点。它死了。

EN: That's one Feral Ghoul Roamer whose roaming days are done.
ZH: 这只狂尸鬼漫游者的游荡生涯到头了。

EN: I'm not quite sure how I managed it, but the Giant Radscorpion is dead.
ZH: 我也不知道自己是怎么做到的，但巨型辐射蝎死了。

EN: The Mirelurk Hunter became the hunted. It's dead.
ZH: 泥沼蟹猎杀者反成了猎物。它死了。

EN: It was close, but I killed the Vicious Dog.
ZH: 好险，但我还是杀死了这只恶犬。

EN: I put the Centaur out of its misery.
ZH: 我让多脚兽解脱了。

EN: It was a nasty fight, but the Feral Ghoul Reaver is dead.
ZH: 这是一次激烈的战斗，但狂尸鬼掠夺者死了。

EN: I killed the Deathclaw! That was way too close...
ZH: 我杀死了死爪！差一点点就被它……

EN: I killed the Enclave Deathclaw. At least now it's free.
ZH: 我杀死了英克雷死爪。至少现在它自由了。

EN: I killed the Super Mutant.
ZH: 我杀死了超级变种人。

EN: I'm beaten and bloodied, but the Super Mutant Master is dead.
ZH: 我被揍得鼻青脸肿，但超级变种人大师死了。

EN: We went toe-to-toe, but the Super Mutant Overlord is finally dead.
ZH: 我们打得难分高下，但超级变种人霸主终于死了。

EN: I did it. I killed the Behemoth. I think I'm in shock...
ZH: 我做到了。我杀死了巨兽。我大概还没缓过神来……

EN: I found an unlocked door into the Broadcasting Tower. There was a supply cache inside.
ZH: 我找到一扇没上锁的门进了广播塔，里面有个物资储藏点。

EN: I successfully hid from the Raiders. That was close.
ZH: 我成功地躲过了掠夺者。差一点就被发现了。

EN: I found a hidden box of supplies!
ZH: 我找到了一个隐藏的物资盒！

EN: I got the Refrigerator open. There were some supplies inside.
ZH: 我把冰箱打开。里面有一些物资。

EN: I cracked the Safe! Looks like there's some good stuff inside...
ZH: 我撬开了保险箱！里面好像有好东西……

EN: Got the door open and explored the Super Duper Mart. I stocked up on supplies.
ZH: 我打开门进了大无敌超市，探索了一番，备足了物资。

EN: The Slaves recognized me as friendly. We chatted for a bit, then they moved on.
ZH: 奴隶们看我没有恶意。我们聊了一会儿，他们就继续上路了。

EN: I helped a dozen slaves escape. To freedom!
ZH: 我帮十二个奴隶逃了出去。为了自由！

EN: I found some unopened crates in a storage closet.
ZH: 我在储藏间里发现了几只未开封的货箱。

EN: I found a working coffee machine! Maybe just one cup...
ZH: 我找到了一台还能用的咖啡机！也许就喝一杯……

EN: I managed to enter and explore the National Guard Depot.
ZH: 我成功进入国民警卫队仓库，探索了一番。

EN: I managed to make some friends. It's amazing what the right words can do.
ZH: 我设法结交了一些朋友。原来好的沟通这么有用。

EN: I made enough explosives to clear the area! Now I can keep exploring.
ZH: 我做的炸药够把这片区域炸个干净！现在我可以继续探险了。

EN: I fled through the back door and tripped on a hollowed-out rock filled with supplies.
ZH: 我从后门逃跑，被岩石绊倒了。岩石是中空的，里面塞满了物资。

EN: Held my breath long enough to find a supply room with a few things above water.
ZH: 我憋着气撑到找到一间物资室，水面上还漂着几样东西。

EN: I chopped the door to pieces and found a large supply closet.
ZH: 我把门劈了个粉碎，找到了一间大储藏室。

EN: I spotted Mirelurks hiding down there, so I turned back and searched the Brewery again.
ZH: 我发现有泥沼蟹躲在下面，于是掉头回去，把啤酒厂又搜了一遍。

EN: I patched up the Slave's Leg. He's back on the run. I wish him the best.
ZH: 我给奴隶包扎好了腿。他又能继续逃亡了。祝他一切顺利。

EN: I stopped the bleeding and calmed him down. Looks like he's going to make it.
ZH: 我止住了血，让他冷静下来。他应该能挺过来。

EN: The Ghoul gave me supplies... and some much needed friendship.
ZH: 尸鬼给了我一些物资……还有我最需要的友谊。

EN: We struck a deal, and parted on good terms.
ZH: 我们做成了一笔交易，好聚好散。

EN: I put the Talon Company Mercs at ease. We traded stories, and parted as friends.
ZH: 我让鹰爪公司佣兵放下了戒心。我们互相讲了讲各自的经历，分别时已经成了朋友。

EN: I helped the Hunter locate and kill the Yao Guai.
ZH: 我帮助猎人找到了妖怪熊并杀死了它。

EN: The Drunken Drifter passed out. More for me!
ZH: 醉酒的流浪者喝断片了。剩下的都归我！

EN: The Brotherhood Patrol took pity on me and gave me some supplies.
ZH: 兄弟会巡逻队很同情我，给了我一些物资。

EN: I successfully brought the Lost Farmer to the settlement. He's safe now.
ZH: 我成功地把迷路的农民送到了定居点。他现在安全了。

EN: I managed to repair the Mister Handy. He told me a pretty funny joke in exchange.
ZH: 我修好了巧手先生。作为回报，它给我讲了个挺好笑的笑话。

EN: I got them off and went inside to stock up.
ZH: 我把门板拆了下来，进去搜刮了一番。

EN: What luck! I found and raided a supply room without making the building collapse.
ZH: 好运气！我发现并搜刮了一个物资室，而且没让房屋塌下来。

EN: I grit my teeth and got it before the Lake's radiation made me sick.
ZH: 我咬紧牙关，赶在湖里的辐射把我放倒之前把它拿到了手。

EN: I found the password! Looks like there's a Workshop inside...
ZH: 我找到了密码！里面好像有个工作间……

EN: I managed to avoid all the traps and found a well-stocked storage room.
ZH: 我设法避开了所有陷阱，找到了一间物资充足的储藏室。

EN: They let me in, gave me some food, and let me help myself to their junk pile.
ZH: 他们让我进门，给了我一些吃的，还随我在他们的废料堆里自取。

EN: They never knew I was there! I even helped myself to some loot.
ZH: 他们一直都不知道我在那里！我甚至还拿了一些战利品。

EN: I noticed a subtle breeze and followed it to a secret room!
ZH: 我注意到一丝微风吹过，然后顺着风向找到了秘密房间！

EN: Boom! I turned a laser arm into a one-shot door opener. Now to look inside...
ZH: 砰！我把一条激光臂改成了一发破门的利器。现在进去看看……

EN: They're now as docile as lambs, so I can continue exploring the Cave.
ZH: 它们现在温顺得像小羊羔，所以我可以继续探索洞穴了。

EN: Got ahold of the reins and stopped the Brahmin! The Merchant then gave me a reward.
ZH: 我一把抓住缰绳，勒住了双头牛！商人给了我一些奖励。

EN: I bumped my foot against something and unearthed it to find a pre-war time capsule!
ZH: 我的脚踢到了个硬东西，挖出来一看，居然是个战前的时间胶囊！

EN: Hint: Some Objectives reward you with Lunchboxes, Pet Carriers or Mr. Handy Boxes!
ZH: 提示：完成某些目标能赢得午餐盒、宠物笼子或巧手先生盒！

EN: Hint: You can turn Windowed mode on/off from the Settings menu.
ZH: 提示：您可以在设置菜单中随时打开/关闭窗口模式。

EN:
There are always three Objectives you can work on.

You can abandon one Objective each day for free and receive a new Objective in its place.

Additional Objectives can be skipped per day with Nuka-Cola Quantum.

Harder Objectives give better rewards.
ZH:
总会有三个目标可供您完成。

您可以每天免费放弃一个目标，并会获得一个新目标作为替代。

每天还能使用量子核子可乐跳过额外的目标。

目标越难，奖励越大。

EN:
The PC Settings can be accessed by clicking on the gear icon in the Pip-Boy. 

By default, Fallout Shelter has the following hotkey mappings:

Esc – Settings/Cancel
F1 – Shop
F2 – Inventory
F3 – Survival Guide
F4 – Objectives
F5 – Wasteland
F6 – Help
B – Build/Upgrade
Space – Quest List
Left Shift – Clipboard
Left Control – Room Action
Tab – Dweller List

Move the camera around by pressing on the arrow keys, WASD keys or clicking and dragging the mouse.

Zoom in and out using the mouse scroll wheel or with the ‘Q' and ‘E' keys.

You can adjust the camera zoom and scroll speeds in the Settings menu.

When Fallout Shelter is minimized to the taskbar or left unattended for too long, it continues to run for a few minutes before going into sleep mode.  

Fallout Shelter automatically and periodically saves your game, but if you want to be sure, click on the Save button in the Settings menu.
ZH:
电脑版设定能够通过点击哔哔小子中的齿轮图标进入。

默认设置中，辐射避难所有如下几个热键：

Esc - 设置/取消
F1 - 商店
F2 - 库存
F3 - 生存指南
F4 - 目标
F5 - 废土
F6 - 帮助
B - 建造/升级
Space - 任务列表
Left Shift - 剪贴板
Left Control - 房间操作
Tab - 居民列表

按方向键、WASD键或点击并拖动鼠标来移动镜头。

使用鼠标滚轮或Q和E键缩放画面。

您可以在设置菜单中调整镜头缩放和滚动速度。

当辐射避难所最小化到任务栏或长时间无人操作时，它会继续运行几分钟，然后进入休眠模式。

辐射避难所会自动定期保存游戏，但如果想更加保险，可以点击设置菜单中的保存按钮。

ZH: 游戏目标

ZH: 电脑版

EN: Hint: Luck stat affects the probability of earning CAPS when collecting Resources.
ZH: 提示：运气值（L）能影响收集资源时获得瓶盖的概率。

EN:
Every Dweller has stats called SPECIAL

S (trength)
P (erception)
E (ndurance)
C (harisma)
I (ntelligence)
A (gility)
L (uck) 

Every room in the Vault is linked to one of the SPECIAL stats. The better the Dweller's stat is for that room, the more they influence the room's effects.
ZH:
每个居民都有SPECIAL属性。

S（力量）
P（观察力）
E（耐力）
C（魅力）
I（智力）
A（敏捷）
L（运气） 

避难所的每间房都和居民SPECIAL属性中的一个有关。居民的相关属性越好，对房间的产出影响也越大。

EN: DWELLERS SPECIAL
ZH: 居民属性

EN: Hint: Find RARE and LEGENDARY Dwellers in Lunchboxes.
ZH: 提示：可以在午餐盒里找到稀有和传奇级别的居民。

EN:
LEVEL

Dwellers level up over time while working in Production Rooms, exploring the Wasteland, and killing enemies on Quests.

Leveling up increases the health of a Dweller. The higher their level is, the higher their health, but Dwellers with high Endurance gain more health when they level up. 
Rooms unlock based on how many Dwellers you have in your Vault.

RARITY

There are three types of rarity of Dwellers, COMMON, RARE, and LEGENDARY.

- COMMON: Low level and SPECIAL stats

- RARE: Average level and SPECIAL stats

- LEGENDARY: High level and SPECIAL stats

等级

居民在生产房间中工作、在废土中探险以及在任务中击杀敌人时都会提升等级。

升级会增加居民的生命值。等级越高，生命值越高；但耐力值高的居民在升级时会获得更多生命值。

房间的解锁取决于您避难所中的居民数量。

稀有度

居民分为普通、稀有和传奇三种稀有度。

- 普通：等级和属性值较低

- 稀有：等级和属性值中等

- 传奇：等级和属性值较高

EN:
A Dweller dies when their health is depleted.

To avoid Dwellers dying you can:
- Give them a Stimpak to Heal them.
- Give them a RadAway to remove Radiation.
- A dead Dweller can be revived with CAPS, or removed from your Vault.

Dwellers that die on a Quest can only be revived once the Quest is over.
